name: Beachcomber Island
note: Island resort: a private island with a backpacker resort, snorkelling, dive shop and the nightly Bula Dance; reached from Denarau by catamaran.

name: Bounty Island
note: Island: a marine-reserve island (Bounty Island, Kadavulailai) with white beaches, a small resort and snorkelling.

name: Castaway Island
note: Island resort: an inhabited island off Malolo with snorkelling straight off the beach and non-motorised watersports.

name: Malolo Island
note: Island: a volcanic island with scenic walks and views over the Mamanuca group; site of Six Senses Fiji resort.

name: Mana Island
note: Island resort: three beach areas, lagoon snorkelling and water sports; a Survivor filming location.

name: Matamanoa Island
note: Island resort for adults: beachfront bures, reef snorkelling, scuba and a hike to the island top.

name: South Sea Island
note: Island resort: a 30-minute day trip from Denarau with a pool, snorkel gear, kayaks and a semi-submersible coral viewer.

name: Treasure Island
note: Island resort: a marine reserve island with palm beaches, snorkelling, a turtle restoration programme and family facilities.

name: Vomo Island
note: Island resort: a privately owned 225-acre luxury island with beachfront and hillside villas and the adults-only Rocks Pool (Wikivoyage).

name: Tokoriki Island
note: Island resort: a luxury honeymoon resort island with its own reef for diving and snorkelling; WV island list.

name: Monuriki
note: Uninhabited island: the Cast Away filming island (2000 film), with white beaches and a pine forest; Wikivoyage calls it very much off the beaten track.

name: Yanuya
note: Island village: a traditional Fijian village known for pottery, visited on sailing day trips (Seaspray lists a village visit on Yanuya).

name: Modriki
note: Uninhabited island: explored on the Seaspray schooner day sail from Mana for beaches and snorkelling.

name: Malolo Lailai
note: Island: a Mamanuca island named Malolo Lailai on the Wikipedia island list; no visitor source gives a draw, so it is listed only for completeness.

name: Sunset Beach (Mana Island)
note: Beach: Sunset Beach on Mana Island, named in the Wikivoyage Mana listing for its view over the uninhabited islands; a feature of Mana Island.

name: The Supermarket
note: Dive site: a reef dive close to Mana Island known for reliably seeing sharks, named in the Mana Island listing.

name: Serenity Island
note: Island resort: Serenity Island Resort, listed in the Wikivoyage Mamanuca Sleep section; a resort islet.

name: Navadra
note: Uninhabited volcanic island with an anchorage used by yachts and fishermen; no visitor source names a visitor draw.

name: Namotu Island
note: Island surf resort: the Namotu surf break and resort off Viti Levu's side of the group; the Namotu Lefts reef.

name: Tavarua Island
note: Island surf resort: a 29-acre private resort island near Namotu, with surfing, diving and kayaking for guests.

name: Cloudbreak
note: Surf break: the headline reef wave off Tavarua, a world-class right in the southern Mamanucas (no article of its own; Wikipedia Cloudbreak redirects to Tavarua).

name: Wilkes Passage
note: Surf break: a powerful right over a shallow reef at the southern tip of a barrier reef, a short boat ride from Cloudbreak.

name: Restaurants (surf break)
note: Surf break: an advanced reef break with tubular waves, off the southern Mamanucas.

name: Swimming Pools (surf break)
note: Surf break: a reef break in the Tavarua area of the Mamanucas, named in a surf guide.

name: Desperations (surf break)
note: Surf break: a reliable backup wave when other Mamanuca breaks are not working.

name: Frigates (surf break)
note: Surf break: named once among world-class Mamanuca breaks; no further detail found.

name: Cloud 9 floating bar
note: Floating bar: a bar on the water near the Mamanucas, reached by boat day sail; a venue, not a place to stay or see.

name: Seventh Heaven floating bar
note: Floating bar: a bar on the water in the Mamanucas, reached by boat day sail; a venue, not a place to stay or see.

name: Musket Cove
note: Resort and yacht marina on Malololailai, a stop for yachts and island day trips.

name: Wadigi Island
note: Islet: two pristine beaches for swimming, diving and snorkelling, with a private resort, west of Malolo.
